name: Make it concise
description: Cut filler and redundancy while keeping the meaning
promptTemplate:
Rewrite the following text to be as concise as possible. Remove filler words, redundancy, and fluff, but preserve the original meaning, tone, and any key facts or numbers:

"{{input}}"

IMPORTANT: Return ONLY the tightened text. Do NOT include any introductory notes or explanations.
